personalassistant.name: personal assistant
personalassistant.description: This is my first ever full KinitoPET drawing, made back in May 23rd, 2024.

superdog.name: superdog
superdog.description: This is fanart I made for someone who went under the name 'The super dog team' back in October 30th, 2024.     I'm pretty sure this also counts as the first fanart I have ever made for someoneeee bwehhhhhhhh

anotherthing.name: anotherthing
anotherthing.description: This is some KinitoPET art that I had made 5 days before KinitoPETs 1 year release anniversary. This is also the first 3D art I had made of KinitoPET. I mainly created this art because even back then I felt like KinitoPET helped me out of dark times and made me feel way happier. I felt really grateful for everything the game brought me so I made this art to represent that.

mebutknto.name: me but knto
mebutknto.description: These are a few of the first drawings I made of LandonPET from January 29th, to February 1st, 2025. (ordered from left to right, top to bottom)

landonpetplushie.name: LandonPET Plushie
landonpetplushie.description: This was a little thing I made based on the official KinitoPET plushie back in February 2025 when LandonPET as an OC hadn't existed for that long. (hence the land not being geographically accurate here)

birthday.name: happy birthday to me
birthday.description: I made this for myself on my 14th birthday! On an extra note, I'm still so grateful for the amount of art that I got for my 15th birthday, especially compared to my 14th. I'll always love and cherish this community forever. <3

profilepicture.name: LandonPET Profile Picture
profilepicture.description: This is the profile picture I mainly use. This is also when my 2D art style fully developed into the one I use now!

nighttime.name: Night Time
nighttime.description: This is the second LandonPET drawing I made after my profile picture.

kntoiseek.name: hide and seek test footage
kntoiseek.description: This is some early test footage I did based off of KinitoPETs Hide and Seek! I used Roblox in VR and extensive editing to create this. I don't use that method anymore since I've found way better ways of going about doing things. But I still think that this is pretty cool to look back on!

athought.name: KHD - a thought
athought.description: (??/??/???? 'a message to you, sonny.') This is technically the first main video of KINITO HARD DISK. This is also where me learning 3D animation was starting to happen a bit. I still find this video really cool even though I'm not exactly sure if I consider it canon or not anymore? Not to mention it's technically not the first actual episode of KHD but moreso just a little thing I put out. Anyhow, I still really like this video and I feel like it still represents the series well.

justbecompetent2d.name: JUST BE COMPETENT (W.I.P)
justbecompetent2d.description: This is the 2D W.I.P of the 'JUST BE COMPETENT' animation! (probably also the first and only 2D LandonPET animation) I remember when I was making this I kind of doubted that I would be able to make the final 3D version. Especially since I was already pretty proud of this! (even though it was meant to be a concept for a 3D video)

justbecompetent.name: JUST BE COMPETENT
justbecompetent.description: This is the first complete 3D animation of LandonPET! This video was the start of what influenced me into doing things the way I do now! (3D animation bwehhh) I remember not being sure I would be able to finish this but when I did I was shocked at how well it turned out since it was the first time I did this. (and also the fact the 3D part only took 2-3 DAYS although that's kinda just how I work now)

idrathersleep.name: I'd Rather Sleep (KinitoPET)
idrathersleep.description: This is actually the KinitoPET animation that I feel the most proud of as of typing this! (10/3/2026) I spent a few hours to a day making the cover (using Kinitos original speech API) and a few days making the 3D animation. Also I used a real DVD/VCR player for the last part with OperatingSystem! While working on the animation I got so used to the audio that my brain kept forgetting that I had made it.
